title: Maim Event
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the MutantMania Massacre and fight Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous. Return to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center when done.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the MutantMania Massacre and fight Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous. Return to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center when done.

Offer:

Friend, Ah have something important to tell you. You've been doing good lately. REAL good. Ah pulled a few strings and was able to book you into...hold onto your helmet...into the MutantMania Massacre!

We've finally hit the big time! You'll be going to the MutantMania Massacre...to fight Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous for the *world championship*!

Your fans want you to win. Manglefeet wants you to lose. Ah want you to make me big money. You want to redeem yourself after humiliating Grapplin' Gertie right out of the fight league.

All our hopes and dreams culminate in this one. Single. Moment.

Sure, we've had some rough times, but, of course, Ah always believed in you! Now, go make me money. Ah mean: make me proud.

Turn-in:

You're alive! Ah mean: you've won! Ah never thought you would do it. Ah mean, Ah *did*, but...well, Ah'm as tickled as a baby in a feather factory. Happy for you, that is.

Congratulations...Ah say, congratulations, friend, you're the new championship title holder. Now you need to make sure no one takes it from you.

Objectives:

  • Defeat Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous

Client level range: 90–100
